subject: Archaeology
title: The Denisovans: A Ghost Species
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Denisovans: A Ghost Species.

hook.text: An entire species of ancient human was identified from a single finger bone found in a Siberian cave.

buildup.text: In 2010, DNA from the bone revealed a previously unknown human species that split from Neanderthals 400,000 years ago.

discovery.text: The Denisovans lived across Asia. Their DNA survives in modern Tibetans, helping them breathe at high altitude.

twist.text: Only five Denisovan fossils have ever been found. We know more about their genome than about what they looked like.

climax.text: A jaw found in a Tibetan cave at 10,000 feet confirms Denisovans thrived in extreme environments.

punchline.text: We mapped their DNA before we found their face.

quiz.question: How were the Denisovans first discovered?
options: A complete skeleton was found in a Chinese limestone cave
DNA from a single finger bone in a Siberian cave revealed an unknown species
Cave paintings depicting an unknown human species led to the search
